answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, each submission carries a fresh nonce. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the crystal until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the hollow of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the opal of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
